# Capital Generations

> Capital Generations provides managed outsourced SDR teams, AE teams, and full sales teams for growing B2B companies. The company hires, trains, manages, and supports dedicated sales professionals.

Capital Generations is based in New York, NY. Its model combines dedicated sellers with sales management, client success, data, reporting, and operational support. SDR teams focus on targeting, outreach, qualification, meeting scheduling, and follow up. AE teams support discovery, follow up, and opportunity progression within the client's sales process. Full sales teams connect SDR and AE work.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.capitalgenerations.com/services): Overview of available sales team models.
- [Outsourced SDR teams](https://www.capitalgenerations.com/services/sdr-teams): Dedicated sales development supported by management, client success, data, and reporting.
- [Outsourced AE teams](https://www.capitalgenerations.com/services/ae-teams): Dedicated sellers supporting discovery, follow up, and opportunity movement.
- [Full sales teams](https://www.capitalgenerations.com/services/full-sales-teams): Connected SDR and AE support with shared management and reporting.
- [Education](https://www.capitalgenerations.com/industries/education): Sales development support for companies selling into education.
